edges.sentence: On 2026-10-08, The Hill reported “A bipartisan pair of lawmakers is urging House colleagues to accept the outcome of November’s elections, whichever side wins.”; on the same day, The Hill reported “Gottheimer is running for reelection, and Bacon is retiring, but both are seeking a pledge from lawmakers in both parties to put trust in voters — and the voting system — and embrace the midterm results.”.

On 2026-10-08, The Hill reported “A bipartisan pair of lawmakers is urging House colleagues to accept the outcome of November’s elections, whichever side wins.”; on the same day, The Hill reported ““Through war and peace, through eras of bitter division and moments of national unity, one practice has held constant: those duly elected under the laws of their states take their seats, and the results of a free election are honored regardless of who prevails,” the lawmakers wrote.”.

On 2026-10-08, The Hill reported “Gottheimer is running for reelection, and Bacon is retiring, but both are seeking a pledge from lawmakers in both parties to put trust in voters — and the voting system — and embrace the midterm results.”; on the same day, The Hill reported ““Through war and peace, through eras of bitter division and moments of national unity, one practice has held constant: those duly elected under the laws of their states take their seats, and the results of a free election are honored regardless of who prevails,” the lawmakers wrote.”.

On 2026-10-08, The Hill reported ““Through war and peace, through eras of bitter division and moments of national unity, one practice has held constant: those duly elected under the laws of their states take their seats, and the results of a free election are honored regardless of who prevails,” the lawmakers wrote.”; on the same day, The Hill reported ““There has never been a more critical moment to affirm the integrity of the House of Representatives and its foundational role in our nation’s democracy,” Gottheimer and Bacon wrote.”.
